question: Which of the following French factories was established in Bengal in 1690 on land granted by the Mughal subahdar Shaista Khan?
explanation: Chandernagore was established by the French in 1690 in Bengal, on land granted to them by Shaista Khan, the Mughal governor (subahdar) of Bengal.

question: In which year did the French East India Company establish their first factory in India at Surat under the leadership of François Caron?
explanation: The French established their first factory in India at Surat in 1668, led by François Caron, who had been appointed Director-General.
